chapter_title: Concerning the Light Mind, why it does not exercis

spiritual_reading.full_translation: Know that enlightened understanding, living within those who are in genuine good, holds the power to bring forth every spiritual work and every confirmation of truth within those who receive it. Yet those who are being reformed cannot remain steadily in the loftier openings that are granted to them, because their state is not yet fixed enough to bear that elevation without relapse.

paragraph_translations.translation: Know that enlightened understanding, living within those who are in genuine good, holds the power to bring forth every spiritual work and every confirmation of truth within those who receive it. Yet those who are being reformed cannot remain steadily in the loftier openings that are granted to them, because their state is not yet fixed enough to bear that elevation without relapse.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS the teaching by distinguishing the power of inner illumination from the recipient’s capacity to sustain it.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Light Mind” is taken as enlightened understanding present within the regenerate; “elect” as those in genuine good; “wonders/signs” as spiritual works and confirmations. The final clause implies instability of state; the exact cause (proprium, temptations, lack of ultimates) is not specified.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Coherent as a single spiritual point: inner illumination has full power for spiritual operation, but the recipient’s formed state limits endurance in higher disclosure.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential (functional) teaching: the text explains efficacy vs. receptivity (power to act vs. inability to persist). No narrative seam, no list of jurisdictions, no governance taxonomy. The spiritual reading did not stumble; it arises naturally from the functional contrast in the sentence.
findings.evidence: Text: “the Light Mind…has the power to perform all these wonders…all these signs…; but the elect are not able to persist in the greatness that may be unveiled to them.” This is a direct functional relation: (1) an indwelling principle has operative power; (2) recipients lack endurance for sustained disclosure. Stage-3a notes confirm coherence: “distinguishing the power of inner illumination from the recipient’s capacity to sustain it… the exact cause… is not specified.” The lack of specified cause is a genuine underdetermination, not a textual disruption, because the paragraph’s point is the power/capacity contrast itself.

textual_criticism.summary: No disruptions detected (0 excisions, 0 annotations). The chapter fragment is a single, coherent correspondential statement contrasting the Light Mind’s operative power with the elect’s limited capacity to persist in unveiled greatness. The only ‘gap’ (unstated mechanism of relapse) is a genuine difficulty/underdetermination, not evidence of an insertion or administrative overlay.

harmonized_paragraphs.text: Happen you know that the Light Mind, who dwells in the elect, has the power to perform all these wonders among the faithful, all these signs that you have recounted to me; but the elect are not able to persist in the greatness that may be unveiled to them.

changes_summary: No changes made. Finding 1 (¶2) recommendation: none.
